title: Alley Catz Bowling
description:
Bring the Bowling Alley to Your Twitch Stream![b]Alley Catz Bowling[/b] is a crowd-play ten-pin bowling experience built from the ground up for streamers and their communities. It’s not just a game you play—it’s an interactive event you share with your viewers across Twitch and Velora.

Interact With Your ChatDesigned for social interaction, Alley Catz Bowling allows your followers to be part of the action. Whether they're cheering for a strike or watching a gutter ball, the game integrates directly with your streaming platform's chat to keep your community engaged while you play.

Master the LaneThis isn't just about throwing a ball; it’s about skill. Take control of your throws with:

• Spin Control: Curve the ball to hit the perfect pocket.

• Direction & Power: Adjust your aim and strength for every shot.

• Strategic Play: Shape your ball path to chase that elusive 300 game.

Customize Your StyleMake every frame your own with a deep collection of unlockable cosmetics:

Bowling Balls: Choose from a growing variety of unique ball designs.

Trails & Effects: Leave a mark with custom ball trails and explosive strike effects.

Pin Skins: Swap out the classic white pins for something more your style.

Climb the LeaderboardsTrack your progress and compete for the top spot. With community-friendly leaderboards and season progression, you and your viewers can watch your skills improve over time as you earn rewards and unlock new content.

Key Features:

Streamer Interactive: Built specifically for streamers to interact with their followers.

Twitch & Velora Support: Connect your favorite streaming platform and play with your community.

Multiple Alleys: A growing collection of bowling environments to keep your streams fresh.

Full Progression: Earn rewards, track season progress, and unlock new gear.

Classic Fun: The timeless ten-pin bowling experience, reimagined for the streaming era.

Important Note: Alley Catz Bowling is a streaming-only interactive game. A Twitch or Velora account is required to play and interact with the crowd-play features. You must be connected to a supported streaming service to launch and play the game.[/i]
description_short: Alley Catz Bowling is a crowd-play ten-pin bowling experience built for Twitch and Velora streamers. Interact with your community, unlock cosmetics, and climb the leaderboards. A streaming account for Twitch and Velora is required to play.
